answer_text:
Here's a comprehensive guide on how to get **free satellite radio** in 2026:

---

## 🛰️ Free Satellite Radio Options

### 1. 🚗 Free Trial with a New Car
If you just drove off the lot in a shiny new car, chances are that SiriusXM Satellite Radio is a standard feature on your radio and free of charge for a certain period of time. If you just bought a new car, chances are you have SiriusXM for free for three months.

---

### 2. 📻 SiriusXM Free 3-Month Trial (In-Car)
Start your free 3-month trial subscription from SiriusXM today and get every channel, including every premium channel, plus access inside & outside the car and on the app.

- The car satellite radio option will ask for a VIN, but that's it.
- Visit **siriusxm.com/free-trial** to check eligibility.

---

### 3. 📱 SiriusXM Free 3-Month Streaming Trial (App)
You can also get 3 months free of SiriusXM Streaming — a $29.97 value. This offer gives you the same radio accessible on your phone, tablet, and computer.

- The streaming option will ask for a credit card, but it won't charge you until the 3 months is over.

---

### 4. 🎵 What You Get with the Free Trial
Both offers give you hundreds of channels of ad-free music curated by genre, era, and even artist-inspired channels. You'll also have access to live sports – including MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, NASCAR, & college sports – plus original talk shows, news coverage, interviews, podcasts, and much more.

---

### 5. 🌐 Free Periodic Listening Events
SiriusXM occasionally offers completely free listening periods. For example, SiriusXM was free May 21 – June 1, letting users listen to great music, sports analysis, comedy and more — no subscription required during those windows.

---

### 6. 💡 Why Satellite Radio Still Has an Edge
There are a whole lot of places where streaming services just don't work — you're depending on a signal on your phone. If you're out in the middle of nowhere, you're going to be disappointed. You can start in California and end up in Massachusetts and listen to the same SiriusXM channel from coast to coast with barely an interruption, because it's satellite-based and the whole country is covered.

---

### ✅ Summary Table

| Option | Duration | Cost | Requires Credit Card? |
|---|---|---|---|
| New Car Trial | 3 months | Free | No |
| In-Car Trial (VIN) | 3 months | Free | No |
| Streaming App Trial | 3 months | Free | Yes (not charged until end) |
| Free Listening Events | Limited dates | Free | No |

---

**💡 Tip:** After your free trial ends, if you want to keep listening at a low cost, you can activate a new radio/tuner with the All Access plan and pay $4.98 each month for your first 12 months.
